metadata.scenario: A patient contacts to book their annual health check-up. Category: Appointment Scheduling. Outcome: appointment_booked.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, how can I help you today? Hi, my name is Patricia Wilson. I was referred by Dr. Anderson about post-surgery care for my mother. Nice to meet you, Patricia! Can you tell me a bit more about your mother's surgery? Yes, she's scheduled for a hip replacement next week, and we need some help during her recovery. Absolutely, we can assist with post-surgery recovery care. Would you like me to check availability for that? Yes, please! That would be great. Could you let me know the date of the surgery and when you would need the care to start? The surgery is on Monday, so I would like to start care on Tuesday if possible. Perfect, we can schedule post-surgery recovery care for Tuesday. How many hours do you think you'll need? I think she’ll need about two hours, but I’d like to confirm based on how she’s feeling. That sounds reasonable. Our post-surgery recovery care is priced at $85 to $110 for 1-3 hours. That works for us. Can we also discuss medication management? Yes, we offer medication management as well, priced at $65 to $80 for 30-45 minutes. Great! I think we’ll need that too. Can you schedule that for the same day? Absolutely, we can coordinate both services for Tuesday. Let me confirm the details. Yes, please do. I want everything to be ready before she comes home. Of course! I’ll set up two hours for post-surgery recovery care and 30 minutes for medication management on Tuesday. Sounds perfect. Will someone reach out to us to finalize the schedule? Yes, I will have our Care Coordinator, Lisa Chen, give you a call to finalize everything. Thank you! Is there anything else I should do before the surgery? Just ensure your mother has all her medications organized and any necessary supplies ready. Okay, I will do that. Thank you for your help! You’re welcome, Patricia! We’re here to help. Do you have any other questions? No, that covers everything. Thanks again! You’re welcome! Have a great day, and we’ll talk soon. You too, goodbye! Goodbye!
